General Knowledge Quiz Night 2025
Think you know a little about everything but not everything about anything?
Perfect. This quiz is for you.
🗓 Date: 18th October 2025
🕘 Time: 21:00 hrs IST
📍 Venue: Google Meet (link will be shared on confirmation)
This isn’t a UPSC exam or a cricket stat masterclass.
This is for the ones who say:
> “I know Sachin has 100 centuries… but don’t ask me who bowled him out in his 105th match.” 😄
🎯 Theme: General Knowledge
🎤 Format: Inspired by KVizzing with Comedians — fast, witty, and interactive.
👥 Team Rules:
Maximum 4 teams only
Each team can have up to 3 members
Total participants: 4–12 people
Solo players are welcome — we’ll help form teams if needed
✨ Who should participate:
People who think they’re “generally smart.”
Quiz lovers who enjoy guessing more than memorizing.
Anyone who enjoys random facts, good banter, and a lively quiz format.
📝 No preparation required. Just bring your curiosity and your team spirit.
